subject: input a table (something along the lines  of matrixInput or shinyTables)

messages.author: 7ba971131927b62b
messages.subject: input a table (something along the lines  of matrixInput or shinyTables)
parts:
I would like to input numerical values in a table format, for instance to compute the Chi-squared statistic on the inputed table. The code below, using matrixInput from the shiny incubator package, installed via devtools::install_github("shiny-incubator", "rstudio") does this somehow, but is not very elegant. For instance, there are now two ways to add rows, one through the UI, one through the inputMatrix. Also, sometimes the default initial 2x2 matrix is displayed, sometimes not.

I would very much prefer to do this through the shinyTable package (github.com/trestletech/shinyTable/), but could not get it to be reactive to the number of rows and columns. Any ideas or hints? 

Here is code that works, but I would prefer the table input to not be part of the UI area:

library(shiny)
library(shinyIncubator)

server <- function(input, output) {
  output$inmatrix <- renderUI({
  #if(is.null(input$tbl)) return(matrix(0,nrow=2,ncol=2))
  matrixInput("tbl", "Enter Data", as.data.frame(matrix(0,nrow=input$nrow,ncol=input$ncol)))
  })
  output$showtable <- renderTable({input$tbl})
}


ui <- shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(
  headerPanel('Simple matrixInput example'),
  sidebarPanel(
    numericInput("nrow", "Number of Rows", 2,1,10),
    numericInput("ncol", "Number of Columns", 2,2,10),
    uiOutput("inmatrix")
  ),
  mainPanel(
    tableOutput("showtable")
  )
))

shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
